The production fix is a single-token correction in AvlTreeSet.last (lib/src/collection/treeset.dart:655): `_root?.minimumNode` was returning the smallest element from the `last` getter, corrected to `_root?.maximumNode`. That is a genuine pre-existing wrong-value defect in the buggy parent 169d026, and it matches the commit subject 'Fix #674 - Treeset.first/last failing' with traceability verified_fix_issue_numbers=[674]. The minimized production patch is one hunk, one line, in one file: no refactor, formatting, feature, doc, or config change, and no test change (tests are isolated in patches/trigger-tests.patch). The triggers are the unchanged upstream tests from the same fixing commit ('for num tree', 'for String tree'), which build a TreeSet via the pre-existing public API (constructor, add, first, last) and assert last == 3 and last == 'zzz'; they depend on no API introduced by the fix, and they fail on the buggy revision exactly because `last` returns the minimum. Strict evidence for both original and post-minimization runs shows all gates passing: build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential with both selectors reproduced, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (4/4 fingerprint groups), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green, matrix.complete (38 runs, 3 repetitions), and selectors.present_and_unique (2/2). active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so the min/max root cause in AvlTreeSet.last is not a duplicate, and google/quiver-dart#674 is in allowed_root_cause_ids.
